description: Converts an arbitrary string to an epoch value using the specified format to parse the string (in a similar way to strptime)

inputs.description: The date/time value to convert to epoch
inputs.name: input_string
inputs.placeholder: The date/time value to convert to epoch

inputs.description: The time format (strptime style) to use in parsing the input_string value supplied
inputs.name: time_format
inputs.placeholder: The time format (strptime style) to use

outputs.description: The converted input_string in epoch format
